Distance = h - h/√3 = h(1 - 1/√3) = h(√3 - 1)/√3
Time taken = 10 minutes

Now, we need to find the time it will take for the car to reach the base of the tower from the second observation point.
The remaining distance to cover is x2.

Time = (h/√3) / ([h(√3 - 1)/√3] / 10)

Time = 10(√3 + 1) / ((√3 - 1)(√3 + 1))
Time = 10(√3 + 1) / (3 - 1)

Time = 5(√3 + 1) minutes

question: Hoses A and B spout water at different constant rates, and hose A can fill a certain pool in 8 hours. 1 = (1/8) * T_B.
